Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by the ongoing price drops on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off and AirPods Max 2 at $100 off, as well as the best price ever on Apple’s AirTag 2, but we also spotted some rare M5 MacBook Air deals – 10-Core base model $150 off and the 13-inch with the 70W charger at $1,199. On top of that, Amazon is now offering Apple’s 20-core 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $300 off and this 16-core model is $500 off. Just be sure to scope out the Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery sitting down at the $59 Amazon all-time low (40% off) and the charging gear deals we have down below as well.

Still live: AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Max 2, more deals (Up to $100 off)

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $145 (Reg. $179)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $119 (Reg. $179 new) – Renewed Premium

Apple’s 20-core 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $300 off at Amazon, and this 16-core model is $500 off

While we are still tracking a particularly notable $500 price drop on the 24GB/2TB 15-Core M5 Pro MacBook Pro, folks looking towards the even more powerful 18-Core model can now score it at the best rate since the price hikes went live at $300 off.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 2TB storage capacity down at $2,899 shipped. This is now a regularly $3,199 machine with the 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU at $300 off the list price.

This is indeed the lowest price we have tracked at Amazon since the price increases and a solid $300 off at that, but if you don’t need the 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU setup, you can score the same machine with the 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU at a giant $500 off the new list price:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 15-core/16-core $2,499 (Reg. $2,999) – $500 off
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 18-core/20-core $2,899 (Reg. $3,199) – $300 off

There’s really no telling how much longer that sizable $500 discount will be live, but if you are looking for a MacBook Pro upgrade right now, you’ll definitely want this one on your radar.

Rare M5 MacBook Air deals: 10-Core base model $150 off, 13-inch w/ 70W charger at $1,199

Alongside the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 this week and some deals on upgraded MacBook Air configurations at up to $200 off, today we spotted some discount on a more affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air. Firstly, a rare price drop on the base model with the upgraded 10-Core GPU at $150 off, and next the same base model 13-inch but with the upgraded 70W Apple Power Adapter down at $1,199.

Amazon is currently $100 off just about all configurations it offers right now starting at the same $1,199, as seen below, but there are some rare savings and slightly better deals on select configs at B&H right now.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,199 (Now Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,499 (Now Reg. $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,699 (Now Reg. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,399 (Now Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,699 (Now Reg. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,899 (Now Reg. $1,999)

As mentioned above, B&H is now offering the base 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB internal SSD down at $1,199 shipped. That’s the same as Amazon, but B&H is also throwing in the upgraded 70W Apple Power Adapter – this would run you an extra $20 configuring this machine with the higher-end charger at Apple, and thus leaving you with $120 in savings.

B&H is also offering the same machine with the standard charger, but this time with the upgraded 10-Core GPU down at $1,249 shipped – this setup carries a $1,399 list price along with the powerful internals and is now $150 off at B&H. This is not a machine you can even buy from Amazon.

These deals also join a host of arguably even better discounts on the latest M5/Pro MacBook Pro models at up to $500 off the list prices:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (Reg. $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,299 (Reg. $2,499)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,499 (Reg. $2,999) – $500 off
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,699 (Reg. $3,099)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (Reg. $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (Reg. $4,399)

AirTag 2 Black Friday in July all-time low pricing is still live ($22 each)

Well there was a countdown clock on the 4-pack of Apple’s AirTag 2 suggesting the all-time low pricing was about jump back up, but Amazon lied and the deal is still live.

If you didn’t get a chance to scoop up the Amazon all-time low Black Friday in July pricing on Apple’s AirTag 2, there’s still time.

  • AirTag 2 $27 (Reg. $29)
  • AirTag 2 (4-pack) $89 (Reg. $99)

Official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery sitting down at $59 Amazon all-time low pricing (40% off)

For all of you iPhone Air users out there, we are touching down this morning to highlight the 40% price drop on the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery.

Amazon is currently offering the Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery down at $59 shipped.

Regularly $99, this is a solid 40% off the list price and what you’ll pay at both Apple and other authorized dealers.

After release alongside Apple’s ultra-thin iPhone Air in September, we started to see some 20% price drops into the $79 range back in mid January before Amazon started to get aggressive with deeper deals on and off beginning in May. Since that time we have seen more than a few chances to land it down at the same Amazon low pricing we have here today.

Amazon’s best quality renewed iPhone 17 Pro units are $220 off, 17 Pro Max up to $450 off

UGREEN just unleashed a 160W smart display charger with retractable cable – grab the new Nexode Pro at $50 off (Launch deal)

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Anker’s 7-in-1 smart display Nano Charging Station w/ retractable USB-C drops to $60
  • Baseus’ display-equipped 140W 4-port USB-C charger undercuts the competition at just $50 today
  • Govee’s unique Torchiere floor lamp comes with three-zone RGBIC control, Matter, more – all at $90 (Reg. $150)

  • Latest Nitro Black Beats 240W braided USB-C cable drops to $18 at Amazon (40% off)
  • This Spigen case protects your MacBook Neo and lets its color shine through down at just $20
  • This metal stand in MacBook Neo citrus is down at the $30 Amazon low, Silver down at $21
  • Twelve South’s PlugBug wall charger with built-in Find My drops to $40 Amazon low
  • Add Apple Find My tracking to your keychain from just $24

Upgrade your Apple Watch this summer while Series 11 is down at $299 (All colors)

The summer is summering, and Apple Watch Series 11 deals are flying with straight $100 cash discounts on the most affordable model you can buy. Whether you have some summer birthdays to take care off, a back to school gift, or just looking to upgrade your personal care routine, you can save some cash.

We might very well catch some deeper deals later this fall, but if you are looking to pickup a current-generation Apple wrist computer for whatever reason you might want or need right now, there’s a ton of cash to be saved.

The 42mm model – the most affordable Series 11 you can buy – is currently on sale for $299 shipped. We featured this deal when it first when live over this past weekend, but now Amazon has all four case colors down at the discounted rate: Jet Black, Rose Gold, Silver, and Space Gray.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $499)

We are talking about a regularly $399 current-gen Apple Watch here at a straight up $100 off the list price.

And if you must have the larger 46mm case size, most, but not all, colors on that one are also sitting at $100 off the list price right now as well. And be sure to pay close attention to that 46mm Cell model below as well – that one is $130 off right now:

  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $529)

All Apple AirPods Max 2 colors currently still $100 off at Amazon

Now on the heels of last week’s Black Friday in July sales, it looks as though Amazon is carrying over the best of its current-generation AirPods deals to kick off another work week. Not only are AirPods Pro 3 still at $50 off, but it is also still offering $100 off all colors of Apple’s AirPods Max 2.

Amazon is now offering the latest 2026 AirPods Max 2 down at $449 shipped in all five colors: Midnight, Blue, Orange, Purple, and Starlight.

Regularly $549, this is a straight up $100 price drop and the best price we can find. You’re looking at the same discount we spotted for last week’s Black Friday in July sale carrying through into this week to deliver the second best price we have ever tracked on the latest Apple over-ears – the only time we have seen them sell for less was for a limited time during the Prime Day event in late June where most colors dropped to $150 off before quickly starting to go in and out of stock within a day or two.

This deal also joins all of the Black Friday in July AirPods deals carrying through to this week – it appears as though other retailers are officially maintaining the AirPods Max 2 sale price this week, but it is unclear whether or not the $50 drop on AirPods Pro 3 will remain:
